mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 2% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth > 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 rises (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment signals a severe labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.5% and PAYEMS declines
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months and PAYEMS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters combined with a rise in real disposable income (RSAFS) signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters and RSAFS rises
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 rises for two consecutive quarters and RSAFS rises (t-test p > 0.05).
